text:
Leah (Marketing Ops): Quick sync — Micro-summit (Apr 28) is GO. Need final registration page, Zoom recording plan, and lead routing before EOD Friday. Main asks: 2 CTAs, company-size funneling, SRT + cloud transcript, 14d open replay then gated, and clip ownership.
Tom (Growth): Copy for CTAs? Short or long? we have space for 2 lines.
Maya (Design): Short works. I pushed a hero with 2 CTAs to Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/micro-summit-hero — check live comments.
Leah (Marketing Ops): Perfect. CTA 1 = "Register - Free" (primary). CTA 2 = "Request a demo" (for >500). Add a small company size dropdown: <50 / 50-500 / 500+.
Olivia (Growth): Routing rule: if company size == "500+" then assign to AE queue (team-b); else to SDR (team-a). Add UTM mapping utm_source=organic, utm_campaign=micro-summit-apr28.
Tom (Growth): HubSpot field mapping — can someone confirm property names? I tested a draft Zapier mapping but want native HS mapping.
Leah (Marketing Ops): HubSpot props: "lead_source", "event_name", "company_size_segment". Example payload for devs: ```{"lead_source":"micro-summit-apr28","event_name":"micro-summit","company_size_segment":"50-500"}```. We'll use HS workflows to tag and route.
Sam (Events): Zoom details — I'll create the meeting and enable cloud recording + audio transcript. Also set local recording fallback on the host machine in case cloud fails. ZoomBot: Meeting created — https://zoom.us/j/9876543210 (ID: 987-654-3210).
Leah (Marketing Ops): Zoom recording settings checklist: 1) Cloud recording ON (record active speaker + gallery + shared screen), 2) Audio transcript ON, 3) Enable "Optimize for 3rd party captions" for SRT output, 4) Disable auto-delete, set retention = 30d in Zoom but we copy to S3 and gate at 14d.
Maya (Design): For post-event clip thumbnails we need speaker headshots and 3 size crops. Who's owning clips?
Sam (Events): I'll own clip extraction and timestamp notes during the event. Sam -> @Tom for final clip titles.
Tom (Growth): Post-event flow: 0-24h: send replay link (open) + CTA to book demo. Day 7: gated access (email capture) for full download + clip highlights. Add nurture path for "500+" segment to AE alert with conversation notes.
Olivia (Growth): Lead CSV columns to include: email, name, company, company_size_segment, utm_source, utm_campaign, registration_ts, session_id. Export to HS daily.
Leah (Marketing Ops): Privacy/GDPR: add consent checkbox with link to privacy. Required checkbox text: "I agree to receive event-related emails and content." Make checkbox required.
Tom (Growth): Can devs add a hidden field source_detail = "micro-summit-apr28" so we don't lose attribution?
Maya (Design): Also add calendar add link (ICS) and 1-click Google Calendar button. Keep form to 6 fields max.
Leah (Marketing Ops): SRT streaming: will stream SRT to internal recorder at srt://ingest.redwood.example:9000/meeting987 — Sam will confirm firewall rules.
Sam (Events): Confirmed with infra — port 9000 allowed from Zoom IP ranges. I will test SRT 24h before event.
ZoomBot: Test recording created for meeting 9876543210: cloud + local + srt stream test scheduled for Apr 27 10:00 PDT.
Leah (Marketing Ops): Ownership summary: Leah = reg page + consent copy; Maya = hero + thumbnails; Tom = HubSpot routing + email follow-ups; Sam = Zoom + clip export; Olivia = AE routing rules + nurture paths.
Tom (Growth): One more ask — tag all registrants who attended live with 'attended_live' boolean so we can include in immediate post-event campaign.
Leah (Marketing Ops): Good catch. Add attendance webhook to HS via Zoom integration.
Maya (Design): I'll tweak the hero copy to mention "live Q&A" and add a 10-min breakout mention in the agenda.
Sam (Events): I'll run a dress rehearsal Tuesday. Can we lock the final reg page and email copy by Monday 11am?
Tom (Growth): Monday 11am works. I'll finalize HS workflows and share runbook.
Leah (Marketing Ops): Thanks all — assigning tasks in Asana now. Quick items: add GDPR checkbox, company-size dropdown, SRT endpoint, HubSpot hidden field, 14d open replay -> gated at day 7, clip owners assigned. React with :thumbsup: when done so I can close the ticket.
Olivia (Growth): :thumbsup:
Maya (Design): :thumbsup:
Sam (Events): :thumbsup:
